item.title: LPG supply concerns: Centre brings back kerosene, coal as cooking fuel amid West Asia conflict

item.description: From the defence space, Jain prefers Bharat Electronics Ltd (BEL) and Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Ltd, noting that the sector has already undergone a meaningful correction over the past several months.

item.title: West Asia crisis: Govt tracks flights, fares as 1.5 lakh passengers return from Gulf
item.description: According to the ministry, flight operations by Indian carriers to and from Riyadh resumed on 12 March 2026, after temporary disruptions caused by regional tensions.

item.title: Only 54 km at its narrowest, 20 million barrels per day: The Strait of Hormuz’s incomputable significance
item.description: Strait of Hormuz disruption: A closure of the strait could create havoc for global energy as this would strand LNG exports from Qatar and UAE – together representing almost 20 per cent of the global LNG exports.
